d:
Anant Singh Daughter Wedding : anant sinh ki beti shivangi ki shadi in dinon khub surkhiyan bator rahi hai. nadvan men huee is bhavy shadi men mehmanon ka hujum umar para. shadi ke lie shandar intjam kie gae the. mehmanon ke khane-pine se lekar svagat tak ki khas vyavastha dekhne ko mili. khane ke lie lanbi-lanbi kataren lagin. shadi men pahunche logon ne bhi intjam ki jamkar charcha ki aur kaha ki aisi shadi pahle kabhi nahin dekhi. aakhir kaisi rahi anant sinh ki beti ki shahi shadi? dekhie ye khas riporta.
